description: This file defines the Language class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class handles tasks related to language management, including adding language generation tasks, dumping language variables into templates, and managing language data before and after controller execution.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language-related events within the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a task to generate a new language list when triggered after language add, edit, or delete operations.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Injects all loaded language variables into the provided template arguments.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores the current language data into a backup before controller execution.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from backup after controller execution.
